workflow: Multiple threads concurrently intern or deduplicate the same value through a shared table.
One thread inserts the value into the table before completing its transition to permanent retention.
Another thread observes the partially transitioned value and concurrently updates or reads its retention and ownership metadata.
Unsynchronized reference-count or state updates race, producing inconsistent shared-object metadata and potentially unsafe reuse or process termination.
summary: Concurrent publication races with permanent retention of a shared value
decision_reason: The bug materially matches the existing cluster: concurrent access to a shared deduplicated value overlaps with its transition to permanent retention, and unsynchronized metadata/refcount handling creates the failure. The generalized mechanism is the same despite different implementation details.
